title: [CQ-V06] Revision bound QA policy
description:
Objective: Require exact candidate/revision in strict review and extend shared delivery policy, not a parallel completion predicate.

Deliverable: Revision bound QA policy. This is task V06 of the approved full CQ rollout; consume this contract, not the whole reference document.

Scope boundaries: implement this behavior and its regression tests only. Later activation, other platform/client consumers and other task behaviors remain out of scope unless named here. Approved full CQ-01–CQ-08 rollout from the interactive implementation plan (2026-10-24). CQ-01 is already landed. Use original Moe source; daemon owns state, wrappers own host Git writes. User selected Moe-provisioned LOCAL Linux VMs (not cloud CI), coding/QA and checks isolated, and exact designated LOCAL BRANCH delivery. Strong profile stays disabled until isolation, evidence and client gates pass. Preserve legacy behavior and existing dirty bytes. Never directly edit .moe. No second revision authority, scheduler, graph database or native memory database.

Verification command (fresh, exit0 required): cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test

Dependency aliases (wired by Moe task ids after import): V05, F12.
definitionOfDone: QA own attempt is fenced without confusing candidate producer provenance.
Legacy omission compatibility remains explicit outside strict profile.
Fresh verification `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` exits0 and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
Create packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/reviewBinding.ts. Reuse only existing pieces: assertExecutionAuthorized (util/executionAuthorization.ts), resolveReviewedCandidate (state/reviewStore.ts), getCandidate (state/candidateStore.ts), getAttempt (state/attemptStore.ts) and readExecutionPolicySnapshot (delivery/executionProfile.ts).

Export `assertReviewedCandidateCurrent(state, task, candidateId, planRevision): void`:
- producer = getAttempt(state, candidate.attemptId); candidateRevision = readExecutionPolicySnapshot(producer?.executionPolicySnapshot)?.planRevision ?? null.
- Error handling: if candidateRevision !== planRevision, throw new MoeError(STATE_CONFLICT, ..., { candidateId, candidateRevision, planRevision }, 'CANDIDATE_REVISION_STALE').
- A malformed snapshot is caught and fails closed the same way, with candidateRevision null.
- It reads the PRODUCER's provenance and never compares it with the reviewer's attempt.

Export `assertReviewBinding(state, task, params: { workerId?, candidateId?, attemptId?, generation?, sessionId? }, decision: 'approve' | 'reject'): { binding: ReviewedCandidateBinding; strict: StrictExecution | null }`:
1. strict = assertExecutionAuthorized(state, task, params.workerId, { attemptId, generation, sessionId }, decision === 'approve' ? 'moe.qa_approve' : 'moe.qa_reject'). This fences QA's OWN running attempt, its approved revision and its served-context receipt. Legacy and observe return null.
2. Not strict: return { binding: resolveReviewedCandidate(...), strict: null }. This is today's behavior exactly, the explicit legacy compatibility, warning included.
3. Strict, in order:
   - a missing candidateId, or a task with no candidate, is MISSING_REQUIRED 'REVIEWED_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED';
   - binding = resolveReviewedCandidate(...), so a mismatch stays CANDIDATE_MISMATCH;
   - only for decision 'approve', assertReviewedCandidateCurrent(state, task, binding.candidateId, strict.planRevision); a reject never delivers, so a stale candidate can be rejected;
   - return { binding, strict }.
The module is read-only, and every refusal precedes the caller's first write.

Wire it into the two QA tools.

packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaApprove.ts:
- inputSchema gains optional `attemptId` (string), `generation` (integer, minimum 1) and `sessionId` (string), each described as 'Optional under legacy/observe; required under verified-local', as complete_task's are.
- The description gains one sentence: under verified-local, approval needs QA's own attemptId, generation and the sessionId that read moe.get_context, plus candidateId of the current candidate produced under the approved plan revision. The refusals are STEP_ENTRY_IDENTITY_REQUIRED, ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED, ATTEMPT_NOT_RUNNING, PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED, CONTEXT_RECEIPT_STALE, REVIEWED_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED, CANDIDATE_MISMATCH and CANDIDATE_REVISION_STALE.
- Replace the single `resolveReviewedCandidate(state, task.id, params.candidateId, 'qa_approve')` call with `const { binding } = assertReviewBinding(state, task, params, 'approve')` at the SAME position: after the summary guards and before the delivery evidence gate. Every refusal therefore still moves not one byte, and precedes EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY.
- Everything else is unchanged.

packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaReject.ts: the same three schema fields, the same description sentence (without the revision refusal), and `assertReviewBinding(state, task, params, 'reject')` at its resolveReviewedCandidate call site, before any write.

The existing qaApprove.test.ts and qaReject.test.ts must pass UNCHANGED, which proves legacy compatibility.

Shared delivery policy, packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/policy.ts. Extend it, never add a parallel predicate.
- Add a private `strictRevision(state, task): number | undefined`. It returns decodeStoredPlanRevision(task) when resolveTaskExecutionProfile(state.project?.settings, task.executionPolicySnapshot) === 'verified-local', else undefined.
- hasPassingCheck(state, taskId, command) becomes hasPassingCheck(state, task, command, revision), and passedOn gains a `revision?: number` parameter: `&& (revision === undefined || run.planRevision === revision)`.
- checkShortfall and protectedCheckShortfall pass strictRevision(state, task).
- Under legacy and observe the parameter is undefined, so every existing result is byte-identical, including runs that carry no planRevision.
- Under strict, a passing run bound to another revision is stale and reports the required-check token: fail closed.
- Update the header comment's REQUIRED CHECK paragraph with one sentence on the strict revision binding.
- Keep V04's landed rules intact.

Make Q5 pass, and keep delivery/requiredChecks.delivery.test.ts, qaApprove.test.ts and dependency-gate tests green.

VERIFY ONCE. Edit only what this step's findings need, and report it in modifiedFiles.

1. Mutants. Apply each to a scratch copy, restore it, then `cmp` afterwards. Each must fail at least one test:
   1. Skip assertExecutionAuthorized for approve: Q1 fails.
   2. Use the candidate's producer attempt as QA's identity: Q1 fails on provenance.
   3. Let a strict approve omit candidateId: Q2 fails.
   4. Skip assertReviewedCandidateCurrent: Q2 fails.
   5. Apply the revision check to reject: Q3 fails.
   6. Apply the strict revision rule to legacy tasks: Q5 fails on the legacy case.
   7. Move assertReviewBinding after the delivery evidence gate: Q1 gets NOT_READY instead.
2. The GATE runs fresh in an isolated Linux snapshot (mem:gotcha-daemon-linux-snapshot-gate).
   - Take `git archive HEAD` of the WHOLE repo.
   - Overlay ONLY this task's 5 files.
   - Run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` after checking that the lockfile matches the tree modulo CR.
   - Use `env -i` with HOME, NO_COLOR=1 and the nvm node bin on a Linux-only PATH.
   - Run `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit`. Both must exit 0. The shared policy is touched, so this is the full suite.
   - `cmp` the overlay against the worktree.
3. A red run outside these files is compared against a snapshot WITHOUT the overlay. Never edit peer files.
4. Supply the npm test command, its exit code and the output tail to complete_task.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
Strict (verified-local) review is bound exactly to the reviewer's own attempt, the current candidate and the approved revision. Shared delivery policy binds required-check evidence to that revision.
- qa_approve and qa_reject on a strict task require QA's own running attempt identity (attemptId, generation, and the sessionId that read get_context, with a fresh receipt at the approved revision) and the current candidateId.
- qa_approve additionally refuses a candidate produced under another plan revision (CANDIDATE_REVISION_STALE). That revision is read from the producer attempt's snapshot, never from the reviewer's attempt.
- Under strict, passedOn counts only runs whose planRevision equals the approved revision.
- Legacy and observe keep today's omission behavior: no identity, and a warning when candidateId is omitted.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale candidate, revision and check bindings fail closed under strict: CANDIDATE_MISMATCH, REVIEWED_CANDIDATE_REQUIRED, CANDIDATE_REVISION_STALE, CONTEXT_RECEIPT_STALE, PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED, and a required-check token for a run from another revision.
QA's own attempt is fenced: missing identity, the producer's superseded attempt or a stale receipt is refused, and the candidate's producer attemptId is never treated as QA's identity.
Legacy omission compatibility stays explicit outside strict: existing qa tests pass unchanged, and legacy and observe approvals without identity or candidateId behave exactly as today.
Every refusal writes nothing and precedes EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY, which still refuses strict approvals.
In a fresh Linux snapshot, `cd packages/moe-daemon && npm test` and `npx tsc --noEmit` both exit 0.
invariants: Under legacy and observe, every existing qa_approve, qa_reject and delivery-policy result is byte-identical.
verified-local stays unavailable: assertExecutionProfileReady is unchanged and still refuses strict approvals after the binding.
Every refusal precedes the first write: no Review record, status change or chat side effect.
There is one shared passing-run predicate (passedOn); no parallel completion predicate.
compatibility: Existing qa_approve and qa_reject callers that send no identity are unaffected outside strict. Extra params are optional in the schema.
The IDE or human approval path is unchanged outside strict, and fails closed under strict.
approvedScope: New delivery/reviewBinding.ts (assertReviewBinding, assertReviewedCandidateCurrent) and its test.
qa_approve and qa_reject: optional attemptId, generation and sessionId params; one call to assertReviewBinding at the existing resolveReviewedCandidate site; a description sentence.
delivery/policy.ts: the strictRevision helper, and a revision parameter on passedOn and hasPassingCheck.
reuse: assertExecutionAuthorized from packages/moe-daemon/src/util/executionAuthorization.ts, the F07/F08 fencing used by complete_task.
getAttempt from packages/moe-daemon/src/state/attemptStore.ts, and readExecutionPolicySnapshot and resolveTaskExecutionProfile from packages/moe-daemon/src/delivery/executionProfile.ts.
sourceAssumptions: packages/moe-daemon/src/util/executionAuthorization.ts: assertExecutionAuthorized returns null for legacy/observe and StrictExecution {attempt, planRevision} for strict.

packages/moe-daemon/src/tools/qaApprove.ts: resolveReviewedCandidate is called after the summary guards and before evaluateDeliveryEvidence, which throws EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY for strict tasks via resolveTaskDeliveryPolicy.
packages/moe-daemon/src/state/reviewStore.ts: resolveReviewedCandidate(state, taskId, supplied, toolName) returns {candidateId?, warning?} or throws CANDIDATE_MISMATCH.
packages/moe-daemon/src/server/planApproval.test.ts spies assertExecutionProfileReady to exercise strict paths in tests.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. A separate strict completion predicate in qa_approve. Rejected: the description forbids a parallel predicate. The check-revision rule extends the shared passedOn, and the review binding reuses assertExecutionAuthorized plus resolveReviewedCandidate.
2. Requiring candidate.attemptId === QA's attempt. Rejected: that confuses producer provenance with the reviewer's. F12 proved the candidate keeps producer gen1 while QA runs gen2.
3. Running the strict binding after the delivery evidence gate. Rejected: strict tasks throw EXECUTION_PROFILE_NOT_READY there, which would make every new refusal unobservable. F12 moved complete_task's readiness check the same way.
4. Applying the revision check to rejects. Rejected: a reject never delivers, and refusing it would strand stale work in REVIEW.
5. Docs. MCP_SERVER.md is held for V12's sweep, and the tool descriptions carry the contract now. Proxy stamping of the QA identity is a package seam: a follow-up task, CQ-V06a.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- util/executionAuthorization.ts assertExecutionAuthorized(state, task, workerId, {attemptId, generation, sessionId}, toolName):
  - every profile: a malformed identity is INVALID_INPUT, and a superseded attempt is ATTEMPT_SUPERSEDED;
  - legacy and observe return null;
  - strict requires identity (STEP_ENTRY_IDENTITY_REQUIRED), the caller's running attempt (ATTEMPT_NOT_RUNNING), an approved revision (PLAN_REVISION_NOT_APPROVED) and a fresh receipt (CONTEXT_RECEIPT_STALE), and returns {attempt, planRevision}.
- state/reviewStore.ts resolveReviewedCandidate: an omission gives a NO-REVIEWED-CANDIDATE warning, and a mismatch gives CANDIDATE_MISMATCH.
- qaApprove.ts calls it after the summary guards and before evaluateDeliveryEvidence. evaluateDeliveryEvidence then calls resolveTaskDeliveryPolicy, which calls assertExecutionProfileReady, so strict tasks throw NOT_READY first. qaReject.ts calls it before its writes.
- McpAdapter does no runtime inputSchema validation; handlers own validation.
- policy.ts: passedOn is the one passing-run match; checkShortfall and protectedCheckShortfall call it.
- Readiness spy precedent: src/server/planApproval.test.ts:1095.

ASSUMED: V04 (task-a9d1a74d) lands an authenticated-run requirement in passedOn for strict tasks. Adapt to it and keep its rule.
